## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? (Not "what should it do" — *why*.)

## Proposal

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is this one better?

## Out-of-scope check

The project ground rules say: **no network calls, the watchdog stays dep-free, safety over cleverness, no telemetry**.

- [ ] This change respects all four.
- [ ] (If not, explain why an exception is justified.)
